english.title: Cause / permit person to drive relevant vehicle on road without a CPC certificate etc
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused or permitted a person to whom the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007 applied, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to drive a relevant vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD..), when that person had not successfully completed the appropriate initial CPC test or Swiss initial CPC test nor was the holder of a valid CPC, national periodic CPC or Swiss CPC, nor had completed a national return to driving course within a period not exceeding one year beginning with the day on which that person completed that national return to driving course had elapsed
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 10(2) and (3) of the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused / permitted a person to drive a relevant vehicle on a road
before he / she had successfully completed an appropriate initial certificate of professional competence test as required by the Vehicle Drivers (CPC) Reg's 2007 / Swiss initial CPC test OR
without holding a valid CPC, national periodic CPC or Swiss CPC OR
where a period in excess of one year having elapsed since he / she completed the national return to driving course
relating to motor vehicles of the category into which this particular relevant vehicle fell

english.notes:
(i) These regulations apply to persons driving a bus on or after 10th September 2008 or driving a lorry on or after 10th September 2009.
(ii) See regulation 3(2 for vehicles to which these regulations DO NOT apply.
(iii) This offence applies from the 3rd December 2024 due to changes made by SI 2024/1160 to the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant caused or permitted a person to whom the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007 applied, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to drive a relevant vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD..), when that person had not successfully completed the appropriate initial CPC test or Swiss initial CPC test nor was the holder of a valid CPC, national periodic CPC or Swiss CPC, nor had completed a national return to driving course within a period not exceeding one year beginning with the day on which the person completed that national return to driving course had elapsed.
